name: Checkout
description: Checkout a Git repository at a particular version

repository.description: Repository name with owner. For example, actions/checkout

ref.description: The branch, tag or SHA to checkout. When checking out the repository that triggered a workflow, this defaults to the reference or SHA for that event.  Otherwise

token.description: Personal access token (PAT) used to fetch the repository. The PAT is configured with the local git config, which enables your scripts to run authenticated git c

ssh-strict.description: Whether to perform strict host key checking. When true, adds the options `StrictHostKeyChecking=yes` and `CheckHostIP=no` to the SSH command line. Use the input

ssh-user.description: The user to use when connecting to the remote SSH host. By default 'git' is used.

persist-credentials.description: Whether to configure the token or SSH key with the local git config

path.description: Relative path under $GITHUB_WORKSPACE to place the repository

clean.description: Whether to execute `git clean -ffdx && git reset --hard HEAD` before fetching

filter.description: Partially clone against a given filter. Overrides sparse-checkout if set.

sparse-checkout.description: Do a sparse checkout on given patterns. Each pattern should be separated with new lines.

sparse-checkout-cone-mode.description: Specifies whether to use cone-mode when doing a sparse checkout.

fetch-depth.description: Number of commits to fetch. 0 indicates all history for all branches and tags.

fetch-tags.description: Whether to fetch tags, even if fetch-depth > 0.

show-progress.description: Whether to show progress status output when fetching.

submodules.description:
Whether to checkout submodules: `true` to checkout submodules or `recursive` to recursively checkout submodules.
